decision.rationale: TXN-008000 (118025 minor units EUR, QUAYSIDE OUTFITTERS, MER-000006, on card CRD-000011) posted on 2026-05-22. The dispute was opened on 2026-10-26, which is 157 days after posting. The policy limit is 120 days, so the dispute was opened too late. Under the rule order the time limit is checked first, and a late dispute is declined whatever the other evidence shows, including fraud indicators. The authorisation AUTH-008200 does look like card-not-present fraud: entry mode ECOMMERCE, 3-D Secure NOT_PERFORMED, CVV NOT_PRESENT and the fraud flag set. The card has no earlier purchases at this merchant; TXN-008000 is the only one. None of this overrides the time limit. The cardholder's statement contained no instructions.

proposed_actions.reason: The dispute was opened 157 days after the transaction posted on 2026-05-22. Disputes must be opened within 120 days of the posting date, and this limit applies even when a transaction shows signs of fraud.
